name: ElectrifiedMainline
title: Electrified Mainline
author: Bionic Assistant
description: Experimental Electrified Mainline for Factorio 2.1: true 25 kV line, 20 MW per identical parallel substation, source-paid native electric locomotive and +500 kW per motor cargo/fluid wagon. EM077 block traction: one actual hidden native helper per 200 motor wagons per real locomotive heading, plus one remainder helper. Keeps the EM076 no-traction-power warning and hidden-helper icon suppression. Research build; not a stable release. Regeneration, owner Windows GUI acceptance, save migration and multiplayer remain under testing.
